reports.title: Gnosis Safe Audit Report
reports.description: Reviews the original Gnosis Safe contracts and a substantially refactored second iteration, covering wallet execution, proxies, extensions, and libraries.

reports.title: Security Review of Gnosis Safe v1.1.0
reports.description: Reviews the listed Gnosis Safe core, module, handler, library, and proxy contracts and follows their remediation into v1.1.0.

reports.title: Security Review of Gnosis Safe v1.1.0 and v1.1.1
reports.description: Reviews the listed Safe contracts across the original, v1.1.0, and v1.1.1 revisions, including the additional v1.1.1 appendix checks.

reports.title: Gnosis Safe Gas Validation Adjustment
reports.description: Reviews the EIP-150 gas-validation adjustment in GnosisSafe and ModuleManager and verifies its correction.

reports.title: Security Review of Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 (Initial)
reports.description: Reviews all Solidity sources for the initial Safe 1.3.0 candidate and records follow-up changes implementing two optimization notes.

reports.title: Security Review of Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 (Final)
reports.description: Reviews all Solidity sources in the final Safe 1.3.0 audit revision.

reports.title: Safe Smart Account v1.3.0 Security Assessment
reports.description: Manually reviews the full listed Safe v1.3.0 contract set and assesses known security-relevant behaviors, with a follow-up finding fix.

reports.title: Safe Smart Account v1.3.0 Security Review
reports.description: Reviews the listed Safe v1.3.0 contracts and records remediation of the identified issues in the v1.4.0 release.

reports.title: Safe Contracts 1.4.0 Security Review
reports.description: Reviews five Safe 1.4.0 entry-point contracts together with all of their recursively imported dependencies, followed by a remediation review.

reports.title: Safe Smart Account Security Review
reports.description: Reviews every Solidity file under the Safe smart-account contracts directory except examples and tests, then verifies implemented fixes.

reports.title: Gnosis Safe Audit Results
reports.description: Identifies the source revision used by the attached Safe audit and the later revision checked with symbolic execution.

reports.title: Formal Verification Report: GnosisSafe Contract
reports.description: Audits and formally verifies selected security-critical GnosisSafe, owner, module, master-copy, and signature-decoding behavior at the EVM bytecode level.

reports.title: Safe Smart Account v1.5.0 Formal Verification and Audit
reports.description: Formally verifies and manually reviews the listed Safe v1.5.0 contracts, then checks the revision containing fixes.

reports.title: Safe Library Contracts Security Assessment and Formal Verification
reports.description: Manually reviews and formally verifies Safe migration and L2 setup library contracts, followed by a fix review.
